headings.usage_rules: No generic sans (Inter/Roboto) for headings. Use tracking-tight for sizes above 32px. H1 max size text-5xl to text-6xl.

body.usage_rules: Clean, readable, slightly geometric but human-friendly. Use leading-relaxed for long-form text.

labels.style: uppercase, tracking-[0.2em], text-xs to text-sm, font-bold
labels.usage_rules: Used for overlines, status badges, and table headers to ensure extreme clarity.

borders.radius: rounded-xl for cards, rounded-full for pills/buttons

buttons.primary: bg-[#701A2D] text-white hover:bg-[#5C1525] rounded-full px-6 py-3 font-medium transition-transform active:scale-95
buttons.secondary: bg-white border border-[#E7E5E4] text-[#1C1917] hover:bg-[#F5F4F0] rounded-full px-6 py-3 font-medium transition-colors
buttons.touch_target: Min 48px height for all interactive elements to support farmer-friendly mobile usage.

cards.dashboard: bg-white rounded-xl border border-stone-200 p-6 hover:shadow-md transition-shadow
cards.metric: flex flex-col gap-2 p-6 rounded-xl bg-[#F5F4F0] border border-stone-200

camera_scanner.overlay: absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none border-2 border-[#10B981]/50 rounded-2xl
camera_scanner.controls_wrapper: absolute bottom-6 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 flex gap-4 backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 p-4 rounded-full border border-white/10

status_badge.pass: bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 border-emerald-200 rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider
status_badge.review: bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 border-amber-200 rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider
status_badge.fail: bg-red-100 text-red-800 border-red-200 rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider

layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-6 or p-8 for containers. Use gap-8 to gap-16 between major landing page sections.
layouts.navigation: Sticky glassmorphism header (z-50). Visible links on desktop. Mobile hamburger menu. Solid bottom border on scroll.
layouts.dashboard_wrapper: Sidebar navigation (desktop) or bottom nav (mobile) with a main content area padded generously (p-4 md:p-8).

motion.micro_interactions: Hover states on all buttons/cards. Translate-y [-2px] on card hover. Scale [0.98] on button click.
motion.page_transitions: Fade in and slide up (10px) on mount for main content sections.
motion.camera_scanning: Pulsing animation on the bounding boxes when AI is processing. Smooth slide-in for result panels.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA standards. Dark text on light backgrounds. No gray-on-gray.
accessibility.focus: Visible focus rings (2px solid primary color) on all keyboard-navigable elements.
accessibility.aria: Include aria-labels for icon-only buttons (like camera capture, retake).
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='capture-button').

image_urls.description: Farmer using smartphone to examine crops. Ideal for landing page hero section.
Premium red onion macro close-up. Perfect for demonstrating the AI bounding box overlay concept on the landing page.
Pile of red onions. Good for dashboard placeholders or batch list thumbnails.

media.icons: Use lucide-react. Standardize stroke-width to 2px for a crisp, professional look.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a premium, earthy-yet-technical visual style suitable for a modern AgriTech startup.
Do NOT build a generic SaaS dashboard. Use 'Clay & Crisp' borders (1px solid, flat background, no heavy dropshadows by default).
Ensure 'Farmer-Friendly' language: 'Check Onion Quality', 'Create Batch', 'View Reports'. Avoid overly technical jargon.

For the AI Camera Vision page: The camera preview must dominate the screen (operator-first design). Overlay a stylized target/bounding box when scanning. Use large, fat buttons for 'Capture' and 'Analyze'.
Use Recharts for the Dashboard and Inspection Result pages (Quality breakdown pie/doughnut charts, storage deterioration line charts).
Apply 'Glassmorphism' strictly to floating overlays (Sticky Nav, Camera controls, Toast notifications). Use backdrop-blur-xl and a subtle white/40 border.
For mobile view: Ensure touch targets (buttons, list items) are at least 48px high to accommodate outdoor/field usage by farmers.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Always add transitions for specific interactive properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (do not add .App { text-align: center; } in CSS).
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like robot, brain, lightbulb for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
NEVER use placeholder URLs. Use the provided image_urls.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.js.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
